assignments.reason: Direction: new | dispatch / prologue fusion (S regime) | Make x-quant independent of the sort, then run sort and quant as one heterogeneous launch, or at least parallelize the sort at n<=640. These 20 Points are 80% of the mean score. Report §4.2 measured the serial prologue plus launch gaps at 16.2–23.8 µs (9.7–13.1% of the call): a one-workgroup sort of 7.6–9.1 µs on one CU, x-quant of 4.6–5.4 µs and 4–9 µs of gaps. The report rates this the top lever, worth about +4–9% (§6.1). The ledger's 'parallel-routing-sort-at-n-640' and 'cut-graph-nodes' directions are OPEN, and iter 5 planned the sort fold but never attempted it. Constraints: keep the exact E8M0 bytes and the shuffled scale layout that stage 1 reads (§7). No workgroup may wait on another. Check with Kineto that 3 kernels remain and that graph minus busy time shrinks.

assignments.reason: Direction: small-n-stage-2-as-a-streaming-persisten. At small n, stage 2 streams W2 at 6.0–6.4 TB/s, while stage 1 reaches 6.5–6.6 TB/s on the same kind of stream (report §4.2, §6.2). Stage 2 runs 6144 short-lived workgroups in 4 rounds with persist_m=1, each moving 48 KB of W2. The specialist should race persistent or resident-slot stage 2 against tile_n=256 at tile_m=32, keeping the KEPT b_nt=2. The report expects −3 to −5 µs (+2–3%) on all 20 S Points. The iter-4 tile_n=256 measurements were taken only at large n and do not transfer to this regime.

assignments.reason: Direction: stage-2-register-plan-for-m-l-issue-a-ds. At L, stage 2 is the largest and least efficient kernel: 1283 µs at 32768, 0.96 PF/s useful against stage 1's 2.0–2.9 PF/s. The in-session accumulate=False probe attributed only 23–30% of stage 2 to atomics, so the short-K per-tile overhead is the main cost. Stage 2 sits at 124 VGPRs with 2 WG/CU, though LDS would allow 4. The matched KB mechanism E21/E22 is to issue A ds_reads one 16-row group ahead, which frees registers so cu_num_mul can go to 3–4. As a secondary item, stage 1 at M/L runs 1 WG/CU (324 VGPRs, 99 KB LDS), and 3816 runs 3.59 rounds and loses to aiter in stage 1 by 10.5 µs; the fixes there are stage-1 occupancy and round-filling tile choices. Keep b_nt=0 at large n: b_nt=2 was a measured negative in iter 5. Re-check the violation fraction at n>=10000 after any stage-2 change.
